name: Plate XVII: The Pyramids of Giza
description: The three pyramids of the Giza plateau under the belt of Orion, the sky-form of Osiris. Struck in Folio: iron-gall ink on rag paper, as the old plates were printed. Degree of Neophyte, rank 563 of the folio. “ORA LEGE LEGE LEGE RELEGE LABORA ET INVENIES”: Pray, read, read, read, reread, work, and you will find (Mutus Liber).
